subject: Renewal: procurement portal lane and capacity uplift - action plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Morales <jenna.morales@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal: procurement portal lane and capacity uplift - action plan

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — appreciate the openness on expansion timing. Per our call, Acme is targeting a January 1 renew + capacity uplift to support the new search-and-recommend workload (estimated +40% token volume). I want to propose a concise path through your procurement portal so we can lock the committed capacity and term before EOY.

High-level proposal (attached: ACME_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing-sheet-commit-tiers.xlsx):
- Term: 12 months starting 2029-01-01, option to convert to 24 months with pricing floor (see sheet).
- Commit: baseline commit with burst credit lane for seasonal peaks (+40% capacity tier).
- Onboarding refresh: we will provide a short vendor packet for your procurement portal onboarding and pre-fill fields for PO generation.
- Security/evidence: we will re-upload SOC2 and audit logs to your portal by Dec 5 if needed.

Ask: can your procurement team confirm the PO routing (billing contact + legal reviewer) and whether we can accept a DocuSign signature via the procure portal? If you prefer, I can submit the SOW as a draft to your portal and loop the right reviewers.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm PO contact and DocuSign acceptance by Nov 30.
2) Redwood sends the pre-filled portal packet and SOW draft.
3) Procurement submits PO; Redwood countersigns via DocuSign and initiates the onboarding refresh.

Laura, looping you for pricing thumbprint and to confirm SLO language for the renewed term.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

From: Jenna Morales <jenna.morales@acmecorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acmecorp.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2028-11-28T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal lane and capacity uplift - action plan

Rafael,

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement:
- Primary PO contact: Procurement Ops (procure@acmecorp.com). Legal reviewer: Sarah Linden (legal@acmecorp.com).
- We do accept DocuSign links from preferred vendors, but needs a short audit trail in the portal first (ticketing number).
- Portal prefers a single combined SOW + pricing attachment; we can accept the two files but will bundle them on upload.

For timing, we can have a PO issued the week of Dec 11 if the SOW is in the portal by Dec 4 and Legal has reviewed. Tom from IT flagged a short security re-check — he may ask for the SOC2 snapshot.

I'll open a portal ticket and add you. Ticket will be 9876.

Jenna
Procurement Partner, Acme Corporation
jenna.morales@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal lane and capacity uplift - action plan

Thanks Jenna — and thanks Tom for the heads-up (cc'd).

We will: 
- Upload a combined SOW+pricing PDF to the portal by end of day Dec 3. (Attached: ACME_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf and pricing-sheet-commit-tiers.xlsx; will produce combined PDF in portal upload.)
- Provide SOC2 snapshot and the short evidence packet for the portal (expected Dec 1).
- Pre-fill the portal fields with PO-level details and routing to procurement@acmecorp.com and legal@acmecorp.com.

Ben — can you confirm the updated SLO excerpt (p6) and sign-off on the 40% committed burst lane pricing? Laura — please confirm the combined PDF and final pricing cells.

If all green, Jenna, we should hit your Dec 4 slot for Legal review and be on track for a Dec 11 PO.

Rafael

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Pricing: the +40% burst tier uses the discounted per-token rate in tab "Tiered-commit"; I'm comfortable with the numbers, finance has pre-approved the margin. Priyom / Ops: we'll need a short playbook for the onboarding refresh (key steps for procurement portal onboarding, credential handoff, KMS note).

Jenna / Acme procurement team —

Portal ticket 9876 is live per your note. We've uploaded the combined SOW+pricing bundle and the SOC2 snapshot to the ticket. Attachments in the portal: ACME_Renewal_SOW_v2_combined.pdf, SOC2-snapshot-2028.pdf.

DocuSign: we'll send the DocuSign link once Legal confirms the minor MTTR change; expected by EOD Dec 4. HubSpot deal RDW-ACME-2028-Q4 updated with commit tier and expected PO date Dec 11: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/142937/company/ACME-0001.

Checklist for Acme procurement to close loop quickly:
- Legal to confirm MTTR clause (Sarah Linden)
- PO routing: procure@acmecorp.com -> finance accounts payable
- Confirm billing code and cost-center (please reply with the 6-digit code)

We appreciate the partnership — once PO is in, Redwood will schedule the onboarding refresh (2 business days) and confirm the capacity uplift window.

Thanks, Rafael
